# LeadHive NZ

> LeadHive NZ is a marketing agency for tradies in New Zealand, run by Joe Ingram. It generates exclusive inbound leads for plumbers, electricians, handymen, builders and roofers using Google Search Ads, a dedicated mobile landing page and call tracking. One business per trade per area. Pricing: Starter NZ$1,500/month (15–25 leads, ad spend included), Growth NZ$2,000/month (25–35 leads), NZ$500 one-off setup, three-month minimum then month to month. Contact: hello@leadhivenz.com.

Key facts (updated October 2026):
- Since February 2026 LeadHive has tracked 1,361 inbound calls (82% answered) and 249 web enquiries for 24 trade partners across New Zealand.
- Live areas average 15 to 50 tracked enquiries per month depending on trade and city (e.g. Wellington handyman 42/mo, Wellington electrician 39/mo, Auckland handyman 39/mo, Hamilton electrician 34/mo).
- Open areas right now include Hawke's Bay plumber, Christchurch plumber, Tauranga plumber, Auckland plumber and Christchurch electrician. Tauranga handyman reopens November 2026.
- Leads are exclusive: the tracking number forwards to one tradie only, every call is recorded, dud calls are removed from the monthly count, and a short month is extended rather than billed.
